english.note: This is the all-purpose noun for physical power or the intensity of a force.
Use 力量 as the all-purpose noun for strength, power, influence, or ordinary physical force.
Use 力量 for physical strength or force, rather than 能力 or 權力.

examples.english: This machine has enough force to move a car.
examples.traditional: 呢部機器有好大力量，可以推郁架車。
